name: Compassion And Sympathy Of Christ The
overview: The compassion and sympathy of Christ are vividly expressed in His invitation to all who are weary and burdened to come to Him for rest. Jesus describes Himself as meek and lowly in heart, offering a yoke that is easy and a burden that is light, demonstrating His tender care for the afflicted, weak in faith, and heavy-laden. This gracious call highlights His understanding of human frailty and His readiness to provide spiritual relief and strength.
